title: Small-strain F-bar limit against a linear B-bar Hex8 pair
source: Foster and Mohammad Nejad (2015), Engineering 7:765–788, equations (4), (5), (24), (51), (53), (54); the zero-strain F-bar tangent reduces to the volume-averaged B-bar tangent. For the two-element unit-length extension with E=1000 Pa, nu=0 and a prescribed 1e-6 m right displacement, the independent affine value is 0.5e-6 m.

quantities.reason: With nu=0 the constrained transverse directions decouple, so the two equal elements carry the prescribed axial displacement affinely and the middle value is exactly 0.5e-6 m; the 1e-6 relative/1e-12 absolute allowance covers the nonlinear solve residual.

quantities.quantity: F-bar minus linear B-bar middle displacement
quantities.reason: At infinitesimal strain the reference-volume F-bar tangent is the existing volume-averaged B-bar tangent; the 1e-10 m bound is the requested small-strain comparison.
